title: Hawass 1992 speech on subterranean labyrinths under the plateau

tellings.quote:
he was uh giving a speech at a
university in Cairo where he was like
there are subterranean labyrinths
underneath the plateau.

plain: In 1992, in a speech at a university in Cairo, the Egyptian archaeologist Zahi Hawass is said to have spoken of underground labyrinths beneath the Giza plateau, where the pyramids stand. A guest named Jay Anderson tells this on the show without naming a source. If true, it would mean that a senior figure in Egyptian archaeology once spoke openly of hidden passages under the pyramids.
